patch.value: Best-effort hook policy unchanged; strict creds only in test/digest real-post

Lifecycle afterCommand hook keeps swallowing all errors (never breaks pm command). The NEW slack test/digest commands throw CommandError(exit 1) when a real (non-dry-run) post is attempted without a webhook, per brief. slack notify keeps its historical graceful exit-0 no-op for backward compat.

Implemented as designed: lifecycle hook best-effort (errors swallowed); slack digest strict (CommandError exit1 on real post w/o webhook); slack notify keeps historical graceful exit-0 no-op for backward compat.
